# Tyler Preisser

> Chief Product Officer at R Squared AI. Builder of AI systems, automation tools, and operational infrastructure. Based in Hays, Kansas.

## Overview

Tyler Preisser is a product-minded builder, operator, and inventor. He serves as Chief Product Officer at R Squared AI, an AI consulting and integration firm co-founded with Rich Rivara (CEO) and Will Godfrey (CTO). R Squared AI builds production-grade agentic AI solutions for PE portfolio companies, financial services, and insurance clients. Tyler also founded Preisser Solutions, an automation consulting practice that builds custom dashboards, back-office workflows, and internal tooling.
